summary: Cleaning and fixing the house can be easy and fun.
description:
This game is the best way to learn how to keep your house always tidy and clean. Enjoy this cleaning adventure while having fun and learning how to be responsible. 

Houses in this town are very messy. Super Fox needs your helping hand to clean and fix the house. You’re in charge to do a kitchen, bathroom, bedroom, attic, garage, garden and living room makeover. 

• Bathroom: Sort the laundry, wash it and hang it on the rope properly. Show off your plumber skills, unclog the toilet and clean the dirty bathtub.
• Garage: What a dirty car! Wash it and fix it, build a hanoi tower made of tires and connect the wires in electric system.
• Garden: Shape a hedgerow in funny ways, plant flowers in the garden, solve a beehouse puzzle and fix up the doghouse.
• Bedroom: This room is in a messy condition so clean it and decorate it any way you like!
• Attic: You can play the old trumpet, find hidden objects in a mystery chest or look through the telescope to observe the night sky. 
• Kitchen: Defrost the frozen fridge with different tools, sort plates at the table and wash the dishes.
• Living room: This living room needs some improvements. Sew up the sofa, light up the fireplace and repair the antique clock.

It’s cleanup time full of entertaining activities. 

Features:
• game with 20 mini games and activities
• friendly gameplay, sounds and design
• develop a sense of responsibility
• earn coins and unlock beautiful stickers
